label: first l/r input at original steps 3-6 after u/v/w in the prefix
explanation: Very sparse unit (0.03% of steps). Fires only during the original-input phase, at steps 3-6, when the input is l (74% of mass), r (19%) or occasionally 3, and earlier inputs include u/v/w (prev2_tok u has 10x lift, prev_tok w 6x). It is the first l/r in the sequence. The strongest activations come on l right after a u..v..w or w..w run, e.g. i u v w [l]. It never fires in the delimiter or copy phases, or on any other letter. The predicate catches about 79% of activation mass on dev, but precision is only about 7%, because most l/r inputs that follow u/w stay below threshold. Requiring two or more u/v/w raises precision to 16% but drops mass recall to 51%. So the exact conjunction is not captured.
